proves.PG-1: an OrgA-scoped subject sees exactly 1 organization and the SENTINEL_SIBLING_ORG_CANARY_ROW (OrgB, sharing CommercialAccount X) never appears (PG-1-1); the reverse holds for OrgB (PG-1-2); current_user_org_ids() is not widened by the shared account (PG-1-3).
proves.N-16: SENTINEL_UNGOVERNED_ORG's commercial_account_id reads NULL and grants no extra visibility.
proves.P-3: reassigning commercial_account_id overwrites the scalar, never stacks.
proves.FK/reapply: ON DELETE RESTRICT refuses 23503 naming the CE-1 FK by name; a second CREATE TABLE refuses 42P07 (destructive-on-reapply, as classified).
